verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents an open-source license or open/neutral governance for Terraform. The only relevant item points the other way: a community discussion of Terraform's BUSL license change and its vague 'competitive offering' terms (terraform-comm-19). That is the relicensing risk the story wants to avoid. A contributor's report of months-long PR merge delays (terraform-comm-17) also suggests vendor-controlled rather than open governance.
